explanation.text:
TIP: OTs rotation depends on V's (skill count starts from Basic attack 1, Ultimate is 4):
V0-V1: 32, 31, 32, 34 (second action after support), 31, 32, 34 (last action)
V2+: Use Total Suppression on turns 1-3 → Support doll moves first and deal small damage in the fourth turn → OTs ults on turn 4 as second action, small damage done is converted into Overload Pulse and is discarded → Turn 4 and 5 damage accumulated into charge on turn 5 → OTs accumulate damage on turns 6 normally → OTs ults as last action on turn 7 
32, 32, 32, 34 (second action after support), 32, 32, 34 (last action)

TIP: OTs accumulates team damage and use it to deal fixed damage. This means usual damage reductions or immunities will not lower damage of Overload Pulse. This also means OTs will always do average more than 10% of whole party damage on V0 and more than 25% of party damage on V6. This feature means she should be futureproof so is very good for vertical investment.

TIP: OTs is considered an Resonance doll all the time despite her Cellular Reconfiguration state. This means even if she has Ice Reconfiguration in Ice team or Zero Reconfiguration due to fixed key, she will be a valid target for Lewis' dolls. As an Resonance dolll OTs benefits from any 20% phase set (not physical) in any team.

TIP: Resonance damage takes strongest buffs from the team and exploits weakest resistances on the enemy. OTs separately picks the strongest phase buffs. Here is an example:
1. Damage increase: 70% Hydro, 40% Electric, 30% Ice
2. Critical Damage: 20% Ice, 10% Electric
3. 30% Electric Attack Power
 The final buffs will be: 70% increased damage, 20% increased critical damage, and 30% increased attack (Note that non-element specific buffs such as Atk Up and Damage Up always applies to OTs. Element buffs such as Blazing Assault and Burning Tide also always applies to OTs as these buffs a NOT element specific).
Note: Unlike attachment sets, remoulding flowers are subject to the above damage buff rules(e.g. OTs in Hydro team will gain bonuses from hydro boost but not corro boost). Due to this, its recommended to go for universal effects such as Ichor Conversion, Headhunter and so on.
After collecting strongest buffs OTs will do damage to the target according to its weakest phase tolerance and simply ignore any elemental immunity as long as its not complete phase damage immunity.

path.note: Good damage for V0, teamwide damage accumulation and crit damage boost, versatile subdps. However your teams will likely still perform better with dedicated supports such as Springfield for Hydro ect. Electro and Fire are pretty restrictive teams to slot her in. OTs also suffers from wheelchair borrow syndrome as her V6 is very strong and common borrow target. On the other hand, while future V0 Dolls are competitive with V0 OTs, they are less flexible as they do not benefit from elements other than their own, unlike her.
